finding: Endpoint-only WAL and delivery-context hashes could treat a different authenticated Paperless account as the old destination. Seen-state filtering occurred before account verification.
change: Authenticate a positive user.id from pinned UI settings using the captured token, no redirects, exact version/API headers and a64KiB bound.

Bind principal to the same canonical endpoint in v2 receipt and marker hashes, retaining mailbox-unit claim identity across versions. v1 bytes and decoding remain valid; legacy/foreign open or completed claims block repost and adoption.

Bind the current principal before cron seen-state filtering and revalidate the expected principal before document reconciliation. A failed lookup makes Paperless unavailable while preserving independent triage/quarantine/vault processing; delivery cannot be recorded.
Same-account token rotation retains the binding; no token, username or profile payload is persisted.

upstream.observedContract: ProfileSerializer omits stable id. UiSettingsView requires IsAuthenticated/PaperlessObjectPermissions and derives response.user.id from request.user.id. Existing /api/ui_settings/ route retained under canonical prefix.

coverage: Nine new cases: versioned descriptor identity/byte compatibility/validation, authenticated HTTP identity and invalid envelopes, real WAL legacy/foreign account conflicts for open/completed and remote present/absent, failed lookup without claim, rotated-token recovery, real SQLite seen-context fencing, cron-helper HTTP/seen/unavailable/quarantine behavior. Three existing real HTTP/WAL recovery tests retain their original assertions with principal fixtures.
review: GPT-6.1 Terra high prompt-only review of supplied design/snippets. Review identified seen-filter ordering and independent processing on lookup failure; both addressed in production and regression coverage.
limits: No protection against coordinated remote database restore/user-id reuse at the same origin or credential reassignment between HTTP requests.
UI-settings permission is required; unavailable/malformed/unsupported account proof keeps Paperless delivery pending.
No automatic legacy-effect adoption, approved rendition changes or cross-attempt vault identity. Whole A04 remains open.
No live service, new current-producer native or release acceptance.
